title: Validate venue templates through declarative rules
description: Generalizes the final LaTeX template gate beyond ASME using class and style-marker rules while preserving the existing compile checks.
changes: Validate class-based templates such as ASME, IEEE, ACM, and ECCV.
Validate style-marker templates such as NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ACL, ICLR, TMLR, AAAI, and Interspeech.
Keep unsupported venue semantics out of the hard gate until a verified rule is added.

rollback.notes: Restore the previous compile checker with ASME-only template validation.
